label: backlog item
definition: One entry of the backlog: one open GitHub issue with board Status Backlog. A small one is a task; a large one is an effort, whose sub-issues are planned when a sprint takes it.
is_not: A sub-issue: a sub-issue is a task inside an effort the sprint already took, not an entry of the backlog.
A light task: a light task is a file under tasks/ and has no GitHub issue.
A sprint backlog task: once a sprint takes the item, its work is tracked in the sprint backlog.
